calibration.scope: Independent calibration subgroup, one cutoff per scenario; test diagnostics reported separately
calibration.brier_definition: Mean over outcomes of sum over all classes (p_k - 1[y=k])^2; no division by class count
calibration.ece_definition: 10 equal-width top-confidence bins, weighted absolute confidence/accuracy gap

conformal.reason: Measured on independent synthetic TEST scenarios, one predetermined cutoff each. Population procedure metric, not incident confidence. Unique-path rejection sampling limits exact exchangeability claims; no real-world coverage guarantee.

feature_definition: Existing sequence_features whitelist; selected model uses only last 3/2/1 mapped techniques, then global training prior. Unsmoothed raw counts; calibration floor applied separately.
prediction_horizon: Next chronological labelled event strictly after cutoff
limitation: Synthetic-trained research model applied to simulated incident. Not real-world validated. Generated paths are research assumptions, not observed attacks; calibration does not establish accuracy or causal prevention effects.
